crossRefs.note: Therefore I consider all of your precepts to be right. I hate every false way.
Yahweh’s words are flawless words, as silver refined in a clay furnace, purified seven times.
As for God, his way is perfect. Yahweh’s word is tried. He is a shield to all those who take refuge in him.
Yahweh’s precepts are right, rejoicing the heart. Yahweh’s commandment is pure, enlightening the eyes.
“Every word of God is flawless. He is a shield to those who take refuge in him.
Therefore the law indeed is holy, and the commandment holy, and righteous, and good.
But if what I don’t desire, that I do, I consent to the law that it is good.
For I delight in God’s law after the inward man,
as newborn babies, long for the pure milk of the Word, that with it you may grow,
For no prophecy ever came by the will of man: but holy men of God spoke, being moved by the Holy Spirit.

translations.web: Your promises have been thoroughly tested, and your servant loves them.
translations.bsb: Your promise is completely pure; therefore Your servant loves it.
translations.kjv: Thy word is very pure: therefore thy servant loveth
translations.asv: Thy word is very pure; Therefore thy servant loveth it.
